v2.05.note: The 2.05 notes announce a Universal Binary; the archived Xcode project specifies ppc and i386.

v3.00.note: Earlier internal 2.32 source also contains a 64-bit build, so this is not described as the first 64-bit build.

v4.50.note: The 4.50 release notes state it runs natively on Arm; the archived app is a universal binary.

v2.32.note: The source ZIP root is texshop2.32-64. Its matching embedded release application is x86_64; 2.32 was never publicly released. Earlier and later normal releases contain ppc/i386, but those architectures are not asserted for this archive.
